svg.title: Service area map
svg.desc: Map of the San Joaquin Valley and the Central Coast built from OpenStreetMap data. Clovis is home base. The service area runs from Merced to Tulare along Highway 99 and west toward the coast as far as Paso Robles, about two hours from Clovis. Highways 99, 41, 180, 152, 198, and Interstate 5 are shown.
